type.provenance: Prohibits sale, manufacture, distribution, and use of firefighting foam containing intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances.

date.provenance: Beginning two years after the effective date of this act

who.provenance: no person shall use, or shall sell, offer for sale, manufacture, or distribute for sale or use in the State

action.provenance: no person shall use, or shall sell, offer for sale, manufacture, or distribute for sale or use in the State

value: Class B firefighting foam containing intentionally added PFAS
products.provenance: no person shall use, or shall sell, offer for sale, manufacture, or distribute for sale or use in the State any class B firefighting foam containing intentionally added PFAS

value: The sale, manufacture, distribution, or use of class B firefighting foam for which the inclusion of PFAS is required by federal law, or by a rule or regulation adopted pursuant thereto, including, but not limited to, 14 C.F.R. s.139.317
exceptions.provenance: Subsection a. of this section shall not apply to the sale, manufacture, distribution, or use of class B firefighting foam for which the inclusion of PFAS is required by federal law, or by a rule or regulation adopted pursuant thereto, including, but not limited to, 14 C.F.R. s.139.317. If a federal requirement to include PFAS in class B firefighting foam is revoked, subsection a. of this section shall apply one year after the requirement is revoked.

intentionally_added.provenance: intentionally added PFAS' means PFAS added to a product or one of the product's components to provide a specific characteristic, appearance, or quality or to perform a specific function. 'Intentionally added PFAS' also includes any degradation byproducts of PFAS.
